themes_detail.label: Dangling Street Signs Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street sign hazards spiked dramatically to 7 complaints this week, a 2,700% increase over the 8-week baseline average of 0.2 complaints per week, suggesting widespread infrastructure deterioration or recent storm damage requiring immediate public safety investigation.
evidence: 7 dangling street sign complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2,700% spike)
Z-score of 15.59 indicates statistically anomalous event, highest severity among all spikes
Concentrated spike suggests localized incident (possible storm damage or vehicle impacts) rather than gradual deterioration
reporting_angles: Physical inspection of high-density sign corridors (likely Atlantic Ave, Nostrand, Franklin) to identify hazards and root cause
Interview DOT about emergency response protocol and timeline for remediation in CD 308

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged to 50 this week, a 388% increase over the 8-week baseline of 10.2 weekly complaints, indicating a new or intensified source of disruptive activity affecting public space.
evidence: 50 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 10.2 weekly average (388% spike, z-score 10.2)
Second-highest z-score among all spikes, suggesting highly unusual week
Timing aligns with potential weekend activity surge or event-related disruption
reporting_angles: Canvass residents and commercial corridors (Atlantic Ave, Nostrand Ave, Eastern Parkway) to identify specific noise sources (construction, venues, street vendors, transit)
Cross-reference with NYPD noise complaint logs and 311 data to map complaint geography and identify repeat locations

themes_detail.label: Street Condition Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Pothole and street condition complaints escalated to 24 THIS WEEK, a 269% spike over the 8-week baseline of 6.5 weekly complaints, suggesting rapid pavement degradation possibly linked to recent weather or deferred maintenance.
evidence: 24 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 6.5 weekly average (269% spike, z-score 5.75)
Spike timing coincides with winter freeze-thaw cycles typical in late January/early February in NYC
Complements ongoing 'Snow or Ice' complaint volume (740 over 90 days) suggesting weather-driven infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Photographic survey of major commercial and residential corridors to document pothole density and severity
Interview DSNY about street repair capacity and timeline given competing weather-related demands; assess whether budget constraints are delaying repairs

themes_detail.label: Illegal Fireworks Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal fireworks complaints jumped to 7 two weeks ago, an 833% increase over the 8-week baseline of 0.8 weekly complaints, indicating possible organized activity or supply availability changes requiring law enforcement attention.
evidence: 7 illegal fireworks complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.8 weekly average (833% spike, z-score 4.49)
Timing suggests deliberate activity rather than seasonal pattern (outside typical summer season)
High z-score and percentage increase indicate concentrated, unusual event
reporting_angles: Interview residents in high-complaint areas (Prospect Heights vs. Crown Heights) to document timing, frequency, and perceived organization of fireworks activity
Check NYPD arrest records and community board reports for any enforcement action or intelligence on illegal fireworks trafficking in the district

themes_detail.label: General 311 Complaint Surge (2 weeks ago)
themes_detail.summary: Overall 311 complaint volume spiked to 43 complaints two weeks ago, a 141% increase over the 8-week baseline of 17.9 weekly complaints, suggesting a potential data artifact, system issue, or broad resident frustration event.
evidence: 43 'GENERAL' 311 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 17.9 weekly average (141% spike, z-score 6.63)
Spike is broad (non-specific category) suggesting possible underlying infrastructure event affecting multiple domains
Lower human-interest priority absent corroboration with specific complaint categories or resident accounts
reporting_angles: Verify whether spike correlates with known outage, event, or policy change in Crown Heights/Prospect Heights two weeks ago
Sample 'GENERAL' complaint text to identify common themes and determine if broad complaint spike reflects specific unmet needs
